basic_info.description: This elegant three-bedroom Edwardian condo located in prime lower Pacific Heights, seamlessly blends classic San Francisco character with modern comforts in a prime location, just a block and a half from the vibrant Upper Fillmore Street corridor. Rich in period details, the home features expansive bay windows, soaring boxed beamed ceilings, built-in cabinets, and two decorative fireplaces that enhance its timeless appeal. The layout offers spacious bedrooms and flexible living and dining areas, ideal for entertaining and everyday living. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances including a Viking range and opens to the light-filled family room overlooking the expansive backyard. Additional features include a storage unit and access to a shared outdoor space, perfect for relaxing. All this and more is close to renowned restaurants, boutiques, and cafes.
